products.title: Coraline Wool Coat / Black
products.body_html: The Coraline Wool Coat is a women's tailored coat woven from a recycled wool blend that combines wool, recycled wool, polyester, and polyamide. The fabric holds body and a smooth, composed face, maintaining the coat's shape through repeated wear without losing its edge. Wool's natural insulating quality works quietly in the blend, providing warmth that sits comfortably between layers as the season shifts. Polyamide and polyester reinforce the weave, keeping the silhouette steady so the coat holds its line through a full day of wear. The tailored cut sits close to the body from shoulder to hem, draping neatly over a fine knit or thin turtleneck when the temperature drops on the morning commute. In black, the Coraline carries J.LINDEBERG's Swedish design sensibility: structure and restraint, nothing added without reason.

products.title: Club Belt DP FOG / Black
products.body_html: The Club Belt DP FOG is a leather golf belt built to finish the look with intent. Cut 40 mm wide and crafted from Pro Leather, it features a golf club-shaped buckle with a rubberized matte finish that complements the leather rather than contrasting it. An enamel Bridge logo sits flush at the front, adding a refined brand signature without any added bulk. The full leather construction holds its shape through repeated wear, gradually developing a natural contour that sits flat and secure at the waistband. Made in Italy, the attention to craft shows in the clean edges, consistent stitching, and the precise way the buckle seats against the strap. A clean finishing piece that anchors tailored golf trousers or flat-front shorts when the outfit calls for something structured and considered at the waist.

products.title: Cara Polo Print  / Orchid Bouquet
products.body_html: The Cara Polo Print is a women's golf polo that brings a seasonal graphic directly into the performance build. Cut in a regular fit, it pairs a TX Jersey front, a stretchable polyester knit with strong moisture management, with a Lightweight Stretch Mesh back that keeps air moving and fabric responsive through every swing. The all-over printed back panel delivers bold pattern contrast against the plain front, while the snap-button collar stand and four-button placket keep the silhouette structured and clean. The Bridge logo sits at the chest as the only branding detail up front, understated against the graphic energy behind. Moisture-wicking and fast-drying throughout, it stays comfortable during a full round even when the sun is up and the pace picks up. A regular fit that moves without pulling, this golf polo works as hard as it reads. OEKO-TEX® certified.

products.body_html: The Dennis Printed T-shirt is a men's tennis tee made from Light Textured Jersey Printed, a polyester-spandex blend that moves with the body and recovers cleanly between points. Cut-and-sewn TX Jersey contrast panels frame the seasonal print with structure that reads as part of the design rather than decoration. The crew neckline sits flat, and mesh TX Jersey short sleeves open up airflow when the rally pace builds. The spandex blend gives enough stretch through overhead serves and wide groundstrokes without pulling the fit out of shape. A regular cut moves cleanly through the chest and torso with room to rotate freely on a big serve. The Bridge sits at the chest and back, with a J.LINDEBERG text logo along the side seam for a composed, sport-forward finish. OEKO-TEX® certified, it carries the Swedish design confidence J.LINDEBERG brings to the court.

products.title: Vent 500 KN Golf Sneaker / Brindle
products.body_html: The Vent 500 KN Golf Sneaker is a men's golf sneaker built around a ventilated two-color nylon yarn flyknit upper that circulates air across the foot through a full round of walking. An Ortholite insole and EVA midsole work in combination to absorb impact and cushion each step, while the molded TPU outsole features Bridge logo lugs engineered to grip turf and stabilize the stance at address. Spanco lining wraps the interior to reduce friction and add lasting comfort against the foot, and the reflective back counter carries the Bridge logo for a clean, composed finish. The lace closure comes with an extra set included, and the printed J.LINDEBERG wordmark on the sides keeps the branding tight and deliberate. Low-profile enough to move straight from the final hole into the clubhouse without a change.

products.title: Tranquil Down Jacket / Moonbeam
products.body_html: The Tranquil Down Jacket is a women's hooded ski down jacket built around a relaxed silhouette and purposeful cold-weather construction. A two-way open-end front zipper lets you vent on the chairlift or seal up fully at the summit, and an adjustable drawcord waist dials in the silhouette when the wind picks up. Integrated Lycra cuffs seal the sleeve at the wrist, two zipped hand pockets and one inner pocket keep essentials close, and the Bridge logo sits cleanly on the left sleeve. The relaxed fit layers easily over a midlayer on a cold powder morning and moves just as well into the lodge when the day is done.

The jersey wicks moisture and dries fast, staying fresh and holding its shape over a long round without clinging or going sheer. A ribbed collar and button placket keep the silhouette structured and clean, while Bridge branding at the chest and back adds a composed signature. The slim fit follows your frame closely without restricting movement, and the spandex content supports a full, unrestricted rotation through the swing. OEKO-TEX® certified.

Finished with our distinctive stacked Bridge texture on the outsole, the Art Signature Sneaker II brings together craftsmanship, comfort, and Scandinavian design in a timeless wardrobe essential.

The Bridge logo rests at the left collar, a quiet signature on a jacket built for active days on the course and composed enough to carry into the afternoon.

The cotton-rich piqué texture feels substantial against the skin, stays comfortable during repeated swings, and resists the kind of cling that sets in when the heat builds. OEKO-TEX® certified. A dependable, well-finished polo suited to both the course and a relaxed lunch after the round.

products.title: Dustin Wool Fleece Jacket / Moonbeam
products.body_html: The Dustin Wool Fleece Jacket is a full-zip mid-layer built from Polar Wool fleece, a wool blend that combines natural-fiber warmth with recycled polyester for structure and shape retention. The two-way front zip opens from the bottom as you build heat, while elastic binding at the cuffs and hem seals in warmth without constriction. Two side pockets and a zipped chest pocket keep essentials accessible on the move. The Bridge at the chest anchors the clean, unfussy front. Cut in a regular fit, it layers comfortably over a base layer and sits clean under a shell, making it suited for a cold morning on the course or a city commute that stretches into evening. A mesh jersey lining adds breathability, and the wool-rich construction naturally regulates temperature and resists odor through long days.

products.title: Feilia Skirt / Subtle Green
products.body_html: The Feilia Skirt is a regular-fit tech skirt built around a lightweight overlap construction that stays out of the way when you move. Made from Sport Jersey, a polyester-elastane blend that stretches with your stride and snaps back cleanly, the fabric pulls moisture away from the skin and dries fast, keeping you composed through back-to-back sets or a long afternoon on the course. An elastic waistband and attached inner shorts deliver a locked-in feel without restriction, and a pocket on the left inner short keeps a card or key within reach without adding bulk. The laser-cut bottom hem removes excess material for a flat, seamless finish, and the Bridge logo at the left hem keeps the branding quiet and precise. Certified to OEKO-TEX® 100 standards.

products.title: Claris Polo / Forest Biome
products.body_html: The Claris Polo is a short-sleeve women's golf polo shirt cut in a cropped silhouette with a regular fit that sits neatly above the hip. Made from heavy cotton piqué, a BCI cotton and polyester blend, the fabric gives the polo its noticeable body and structure, holding its shape through a full round without going limp in the heat. The ribbed collar with contrast tipping keeps a sharp line from the first tee to the clubhouse, while the J.LINDEBERG script logo across the back makes its presence known at address and on the walk off the green. The Bridge logo at the chest adds a clean, understated signature. OEKO-TEX® certified. Worn with high-waist trousers or a tailored skirt, it carries that same composed energy across town on a Friday evening as it does on the course.

products.title: Amy Print Skirt / Bunker Fade Black Moonbeam M
products.body_html: The Amy Print Skirt is a printed golf tech skirt engineered for all-day movement and warm-weather rounds. Made from TXJersey, a four-way stretch fabric with built-in moisture management, it pulls sweat away from the skin and dries fast when the sun is high and the pace picks up. The all-over print adds graphic energy without compromising the clean, sport-forward silhouette. Attached inner shorts provide coverage through every swing and stride without adding bulk, while side slits open the hem for unrestricted rotation. A back zipper pocket secures essentials mid-round, and the regular fit lands at a 15-inch center back length for a proportioned line. Bridge logo detailing at the back and hem gives the skirt its J.LINDEBERG signature. OEKO-TEX® certified.

products.title: Selena Quarter Zip Mid Layer / White
products.body_html: The Selena Quarter-Zip Mid Layer is a women's golf mid layer built for active rounds when the temperature drops but the pace stays high. The quarter-zip closure features a stay-down puller and a double chin guard for quick ventilation without distraction, while zipped side pockets keep small essentials secure and close to hand. A silicone Bridge logo on the sleeve and J.LINDEBERG script print along the zipper deliver a clean, composed finish. The regular fit sits close without restricting arm rotation, and layers neatly under a shell when conditions shift or the wind picks up.

products.title: Aella Flared Skirt / Forest Biome
products.body_html: The Aella Flared Skirt is a women's golf tech skirt built from four-way stretch Sport Jersey that responds cleanly to every swing and stride. The fabric's moisture management system draws sweat away from the skin and dries fast, keeping you dry and focused through warm rounds and extended practice sessions. The folded turtleneck sits naturally at the collar, adding warmth and coverage on colder mornings without the bulk of a knit beneath a jacket, and double-needle stitched hems keep the edges flat after washing. A raised rubber J.LINDEBERG print on the chest lands with quiet confidence. The slim cut skims the torso closely without restricting movement, and the breathable organic cotton rib keeps things composed through long days indoors or out. The viscose in the blend softens the character of the wool, keeping the exterior smooth and the silhouette clean through repeated wear without pilling or distortion. A high-shine Bridge logo on the front panel carries J.LINDEBERG's Swedish design identity with quiet confidence. Cut in a regular, unisex fit, the cap sits naturally on a frost-covered morning round, pulled low against the kind of wind that cuts across an open fairway, and holds up just as well during a cold city commute when the course is behind you and the pace does not slow.

The regular fit sits cleanly over a knit or midlayer and moves without resistance through a cold morning commute or a long weekend day in the city.
